lessons.titleZh: 對不同人喚起不同情感

brief.meaningEn: Evoke different feelings in different audiences through the same work or event.
brief.meaningZh: 同一作品或活動令不同觀眾產生不同感受。
brief.grammar: A story, performance or image can speak different emotional languages to two named audiences; the languages are figurative.
brief.register: Discussion of art, stories and audience response.
brief.boundaryZh: 須指出至少兩組觀眾及各自的情感反應；不是說他們使用不同口語，也不表示兩組人互不理解。
brief.misconceptionZh: 與「兩人有相同情感語言」不同；這裏是一件作品對不同群體產生不同情緒效果。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出同一作品如何分別觸動兩組觀眾，並自然運用情感語言的比喻。

sources.sentence: The story can speak different emotional languages to children and parents.

listening.en: At the puppet show, children cheered for the daring journey, while grandparents grew quiet at a song from their youth. The show spoke different emotional languages to the two groups.
listening.zh: 木偶劇中，孩子為勇敢的旅程歡呼，祖父母聽到年輕時的歌曲則安靜下來；同一齣劇對兩組人喚起不同情感。
listening.promptZh: 木偶劇對兩組觀眾有甚麼不同作用？

options.en: It excited the children but stirred memories in the grandparents.
options.zh: 它令孩子興奮，卻喚起祖父母的回憶。

options.en: Both groups enjoyed the puppet craft for the same reason.
options.zh: 兩組人都因相同原因欣賞木偶製作。

options.en: The grandparents were mainly reacting to the children’s cheering.
options.zh: 祖父母主要是對孩子的歡呼作出反應。

options.en: The song gave children and grandparents the same feeling.
options.zh: 那首歌令孩子和祖父母產生相同感受。

listening.explanationZh: 孩子歡呼與長輩沉靜回憶是不同情感反應；不能推斷他們的興趣或反應完全相同。

reply.promptEn: How did the play affect the younger and older viewers?
reply.promptZh: （這齣劇怎樣影響年輕和年長觀眾？）

options.en: The children enjoyed the chase, while the closing song made older viewers nostalgic.
options.zh: 孩子喜歡追逐情節，片尾曲則令年長觀眾感到懷念。

options.en: It spoke different emotional languages to younger and older viewers.
options.zh: 它對年輕和年長觀眾喚起不同情感。

options.en: The younger audience felt excited, whereas the older audience felt nostalgic.
options.zh: 年輕觀眾感到興奮，年長觀眾則感到懷念。

options.en: Different scenes gave the two age groups different feelings to take away.
options.zh: 不同場景令兩個年齡層觀眾留下不同感受。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都可描述觀眾反應；金句概括同一作品如何觸動不同年齡層。

scene.promptZh: 一個社區展覽同時展示孩子畫的未來街道和長者拍的舊街照片；孩子充滿好奇，長者感到懷念。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The exhibition speaks different emotional languages to children and older residents.
options.zh: 展覽對孩子和年長居民喚起不同情感。

options.en: The exhibition gives both groups a chance to compare old and new streets.
options.zh: 展覽讓兩組人有機會比較新舊街道。

options.en: Children were nostalgic about the old shops, while older residents focused on the new art.
options.zh: 孩子懷念舊店，年長居民則較留意新的藝術作品。

scene.explanationZh: 好奇與懷念分屬不同情感；比較街道只是活動內容，沒有概括兩組人的感受。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個情況最不支持「speaks different emotional languages」？

options.en: One song makes children dance and adults remember an old friend.
options.zh: 同一首歌令孩子起舞，亦令成年人想起舊友。

options.en: A film prompts one group to laugh and another to feel uneasy.
options.zh: 一齣電影令一組人發笑，另一組人感到不安。

options.en: Everyone in the audience reports the same feeling for the same reason.
options.zh: 所有觀眾都因同一原因報告相同感受。

contrast.explanationZh: 若觀眾的情緒與原因都相同，便沒有「不同情感語言」的對比。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友問：「為甚麼孩子覺得這部短片有趣，家長卻看得眼泛淚光？」你怎樣回答最完整？

options.en: It speaks different emotional languages to them: the children see adventure, while the parents recall their own childhood.
options.zh: 它對兩組人喚起不同情感：孩子看見冒險，家長則想起自己的童年。

options.en: The children noticed the comic scenes more quickly.
options.zh: 孩子較快留意到滑稽的場景。

options.en: The parents may have recognised a place from their childhood.
options.zh: 家長可能認出童年熟悉的地方。

dialogue.explanationZh: 金句同時解釋兩組人的不同感受；其他回答只提一組人的反應。

speaking.en: The mural spoke different emotional languages to the pupils and their grandparents.
speaking.zh: 這幅壁畫對學生和他們的祖父母喚起不同情感。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說出同一作品如何觸動兩組人。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：一張社區口述歷史地圖標出昔日商店與今天的街頭藝術。青少年想探索新作品，老街坊想起已結業的店。用一至兩句英文描述同一張地圖帶來的不同情感。
writing.selfCheckZh: 清楚指出兩組人及各自的感受；不要說他們使用不同口語。

examples.en: The history map speaks different emotional languages to teenagers and older neighbours: one group feels curious, while the other remembers lost shops.
examples.zh: 口述歷史地圖對青少年和老街坊喚起不同情感：前者感到好奇，後者想起已結業的店。

examples.en: Street-art markers excite younger visitors, but the old shop names stir memories among longtime residents; the map speaks different emotional languages to them.
examples.zh: 街頭藝術標記令年輕訪客興奮，舊店名稱則勾起老街坊的回憶；地圖對兩組人喚起不同情感。

takeaways.en: The same photograph can speak different emotional languages to a newcomer and a former resident.
takeaways.zh: 同一張照片可以令新來者和昔日居民產生不同感受。

takeaways.en: A performance spoke different emotional languages to the two families without dividing them.
takeaways.zh: 一場表演令兩個家庭產生不同感受，但沒有令他們疏遠。

brief.meaningEn: Prevent considerable anxiety by giving timely, useful reassurance or information.
brief.meaningZh: 藉及時而有用的訊息，免去不少擔憂。
brief.grammar: Save someone a lot of worry takes a person or group object; save a lot of worry is also possible without naming the person.
brief.register: Everyday discussion of updates, planning and reassurance.
brief.boundaryZh: 重點是減少不必要的擔心，不保證事情完全沒有風險或已全部解決。
brief.misconceptionZh: 這裏的 save 不是省錢；一句空泛安慰未必能省卻擔憂，訊息應具體可信。
brief.outcomeZh: 能說明哪項及時資訊如何減少某人的擔憂，同時保留尚未確定的部分。

sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 39, row 5; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: A quick update can save a lot of worry.

listening.en: Before the school trip, the coach sent parents a message confirming that the delayed bus had been replaced. The update saved them a lot of worry, although arrival would still be late.
listening.zh: 學校旅行前，教練通知家長延誤的巴士已獲替換；雖然仍會遲到，這則消息讓家長少了許多擔憂。
listening.promptZh: 這則消息帶來甚麼作用？

options.en: It reassured parents about the bus while leaving the delay clear.
options.zh: 它讓家長知道已有巴士接替，同時沒有隱瞞延誤。

options.en: The message gave parents an exact revised arrival time.
options.zh: 訊息向家長提供了確切的更新後抵達時間。

options.en: It meant the replacement bus was not needed after all.
options.zh: 這表示最終不需要替換巴士。

options.en: It told parents to use a different pickup point.
options.zh: 它通知家長改用另一個接送地點。

listening.explanationZh: 替換巴士的具體資訊可減少焦慮，但不能消除已知的延誤。

reply.promptEn: Why was the early transport update useful to parents?
reply.promptZh: （提早通知交通安排為何對家長有用？）

options.en: It told them a replacement bus was ready.
options.zh: 它讓家長知道替換巴士已準備好。

options.en: It saved the parents a lot of worry while they waited.
options.zh: 它讓等待中的家長少了許多擔憂。

options.en: It helped them adjust their pickup time.
options.zh: 它幫助家長調整接送時間。

options.en: It meant they did not have to keep calling for the same update.
options.zh: 它令家長不用為同一消息反覆致電。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都說明通知的好處；金句以本課搭配指出擔憂減少。

scene.promptZh: 獸醫診所先通知主人血液樣本已安全送抵實驗室，但結果仍要兩天才出。哪句最貼切？

options.en: That confirmation may save the owner a lot of worry about the sample being lost.
options.zh: 這項確認可讓主人少擔心樣本會遺失。

options.en: The confirmation tells the owner that the test result will be favourable.
options.zh: 這項確認告訴主人檢驗結果一定理想。

options.en: The clinic has reduced the waiting time for the result to a few hours.
options.zh: 診所已把等候結果的時間縮短至數小時。

scene.explanationZh: 主人得知樣本已送達，可免去一部分擔心；檢驗結果仍未知。

contrast.promptZh: 哪句最不能支持「save a lot of worry」？

options.en: A confirmed schedule lets families arrange collection in advance.
options.zh: 經確認的時間表讓家庭預先安排接送。

options.en: A clear status report tells a customer what has been checked and what remains.
options.zh: 清楚的進度報告告訴顧客已檢查甚麼，以及還欠甚麼。

options.en: A vague message says “do not worry” but gives no information about the missing parcel.
options.zh: 空泛訊息只說「別擔心」，卻沒有提供遺失包裹的資訊。

contrast.explanationZh: 缺乏具體資訊的空泛安慰，難以證明已消除擔憂的原因。

dialogue.promptZh: 同事說：「家長還在問巴士是否有接替安排。」你已收到替換巴士的確認。哪句最合適？

options.en: Send the confirmed bus details now; that could save them a lot of worry, even if we still need to update the arrival time.
options.zh: 現在傳送已確認的巴士資料吧；即使稍後仍要更新到達時間，也能讓家長少擔心。

options.en: We should wait until every minute of the route is certain before saying anything.
options.zh: 等路程每分鐘都確定後，我們才公布消息吧。

options.en: Tell them the bus number first and promise a later arrival-time update.
options.zh: 先告訴家長巴士號碼，再承諾稍後更新到達時間。

dialogue.explanationZh: 金句提出具體及時資訊，並沒有假裝全部細節已確定。

speaking.en: A confirmed pickup message could save the parents a lot of worry during the delay.
speaking.zh: 延誤期間，一則已確認的接送消息可以令家長少了許多擔憂。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說出哪項消息可減少誰的擔心。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：農墟主辦方提早兩天確認一名檔主的攤位和卸貨時間，但天氣安排仍待公布。用一至兩句英文說明及時確認如何幫助檔主，並保留尚未確定的事。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出具體已確認事項與仍待公布的資訊；不要說所有問題都已解決。

examples.en: Confirming the stall number and unloading time saved the vendor a lot of worry, although the weather plan is still pending.
examples.zh: 提早確認攤位號碼與卸貨時間，讓檔主少了許多擔憂，雖然天氣安排仍待公布。

examples.en: The organiser confirmed the stall number and unloading time two days early, which could save the vendor a lot of worry; the weather plan is still pending.
examples.zh: 主辦方提早兩天確認攤位號碼和卸貨時間，可讓檔主少了許多擔憂；天氣安排仍待公布。

takeaways.en: A precise collection time can save a lot of worry for someone waiting at home.
takeaways.zh: 確切的領取時間可令在家等候的人少了許多擔憂。

takeaways.en: The nurse’s short status update saved the family a lot of worry without promising a diagnosis.
takeaways.zh: 護士的簡短進度消息令家人少了許多擔憂，卻沒有預先保證診斷結果。

brief.meaningEn: Keep choosing one musical genre or tradition instead of exploring other styles.
brief.meaningZh: 一直選擇同一類音樂，而較少接觸其他風格。
brief.grammar: Stay in one musical lane is a figurative choice about music; negatives such as does not stay in one musical lane express variety.
brief.register: Casual talk about listening, DJ sets and musical tastes.
brief.boundaryZh: 重點是音樂類型的選擇，未必表示能力不足或被迫局限；也不是指道路上的車道。
brief.misconceptionZh: 只選一類音樂不等於這類音樂品質較差；不應推斷某人永遠不能嘗試別的風格。
brief.outcomeZh: 能分辨自願維持同一音樂風格與跨類型探索，並用比喻描述選擇。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 51, row 3; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: She does not stay in one musical lane for long.

listening.en: For this month’s radio set, Leo chooses only acoustic folk songs, even though he knows other genres well. He is choosing to stay in one musical lane for now.
listening.zh: 本月的電台歌單中，利奧只選木結他民謠，雖然他也熟悉其他類型；目前他主動選擇只播放一類音樂。
listening.promptZh: 利奧本月的選曲方式是甚麼？

options.en: He is deliberately focusing on one style for this set.
options.zh: 他刻意在這輯歌單集中選用一種風格。

options.en: He chose folk because the station had no other records available.
options.zh: 他選民謠是因為電台沒有其他可用唱片。

options.en: He was introducing a different genre alongside folk each week.
options.zh: 他每週都在民謠以外加入不同音樂類型。

options.en: He planned to use folk for one show and then switch styles the next day.
options.zh: 他打算只在一集節目播民謠，翌日便轉換風格。

listening.explanationZh: 他明知其他類型，仍暫時選擇集中於民謠；不能推斷能力或永久限制。

reply.promptEn: How is the host choosing music for this month’s programme?
reply.promptZh: （主持人本月的節目怎樣選曲？）

options.en: He is focusing on acoustic folk songs.
options.zh: 他集中選擇木結他民謠。

options.en: He plans to keep the set within one genre.
options.zh: 他打算讓歌單維持在一個類型之內。

options.en: He is staying in one musical lane for this month’s programme.
options.zh: 他本月節目暫時只選一類音樂。

options.en: He is deliberately leaving other genres out of this month’s programme.
options.zh: 他刻意不把其他音樂類型放進本月節目。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都可描述選曲方式；金句運用音樂車道的比喻。

scene.promptZh: 社區合唱團這季只排練爵士改編曲，雖有民謠和古典曲譜可選；領隊說這是本季主題。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The choir is staying in one musical lane this season by choice.
options.zh: 合唱團這季自行選擇集中於一種音樂風格。

options.en: The season focuses on jazz because the choir has no other scores.
options.zh: 這一季集中爵士，是因為合唱團沒有其他曲譜。

options.en: The choir plans to add folk songs to every rehearsal this season.
options.zh: 合唱團計劃這季每次排練都加入民謠。

scene.explanationZh: 本季專注爵士是明確的主題選擇，不表示其他風格不能唱。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個情況最不符合 stay in one musical lane？

options.en: A DJ plays only soul records for a themed evening.
options.zh: 唱片騎師在主題之夜只播放騷靈樂唱片。

options.en: A listener tries classical, hip-hop and traditional music each week.
options.zh: 聽眾每週都接觸古典、嘻哈和傳統音樂。

options.en: A choir chooses only jazz pieces for one season.
options.zh: 合唱團一季只選爵士樂曲。

contrast.explanationZh: 每週主動嘗試多種風格，正好與只待在一個音樂類型相反。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友問：「她有很多類型的唱片，為甚麼今晚卻只播藍調？」你知道今晚是專題分享。哪句最合適？

options.en: She is staying in one musical lane tonight because the session is devoted to blues, not because she dislikes other music.
options.zh: 今晚她只播藍調，是因為這場分享有特定主題，不代表她討厭其他音樂。

options.en: She chose blues songs that fit the evening’s topic.
options.zh: 她選了符合今晚主題的藍調歌曲。

options.en: The rest of her collection can be featured another night.
options.zh: 她其他唱片可留待另一晚介紹。

dialogue.explanationZh: 金句解釋暫時集中於一類音樂，也避免誤判她對其他類型的態度。

speaking.en: For the festival set, the group stayed in one musical lane and played only folk songs.
speaking.zh: 這組人在音樂節的演出集中於一種風格，只唱民謠。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說出選曲如何集中於一個類型。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：一個新播客擁有大量不同風格的唱片，但第一季決定只介紹城市藍調；主持人說往後仍可能做其他主題。用一至兩句英文描述這個暫時選擇。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出第一季專注哪一類音樂，並避免說主持人不懂或討厭其他風格。

examples.en: The podcast is staying in one musical lane for its first season, focusing on urban blues even though its archive holds other genres.
examples.zh: 播客第一季暫時只介紹一類音樂，集中於城市藍調，儘管資料庫還有其他類型。

examples.en: For now, the host stays in one musical lane with blues records, but a later season could explore a different tradition.
examples.zh: 目前主持人只介紹藍調唱片，但往後一季可以探索另一種音樂傳統。

takeaways.en: A themed playlist can stay in one musical lane without limiting its maker forever.
takeaways.zh: 主題歌單可以暫時集中於一種風格，卻不會永久限制製作人。

takeaways.en: She did not stay in one musical lane: her next set moved from jazz to traditional songs.
takeaways.zh: 她沒有只停留在一種音樂風格：下一輯歌單從爵士轉到傳統歌曲。

brief.meaningEn: Become less rigid about an opinion or policy without necessarily reversing it.
brief.meaningZh: 對某立場不再那麼堅持，但未必完全改變看法。
brief.grammar: Use soften one’s stance or one’s stance may soften; identify the view and evidence behind a possible shift.
brief.register: Discussion of decisions, negotiations and evolving opinions.
brief.boundaryZh: 表示立場有可能變得較不強硬，不等於已完全同意對方；若只談實物變軟，便不是本課意思。
brief.misconceptionZh: 聽取新證據不保證一定讓步；may、might 等語氣須如實保留。
brief.outcomeZh: 能描述一方在聽取理由後可能放鬆立場，同時避免誇大為已完全改變決定。

sources.sentence: With time, her stance may gradually soften.

listening.en: The head teacher first rejected a later library closing time. After hearing how it would help working families, her stance may soften, though she has not decided yet.
listening.zh: 校長起初反對圖書館延遲關門；聽到這樣可幫助在職家庭後，她的立場可能會放鬆，但仍未作決定。
listening.promptZh: 校長的立場目前有甚麼可能變化？

options.en: She may become less opposed, although no decision has been made.
options.zh: 她可能不再那麼反對，但尚未作決定。

options.en: She has agreed to a permanent later closing time.
options.zh: 她已同意永久延遲關門。

options.en: She has promised a short trial of later hours, though not a permanent change.
options.zh: 她已答應短期試行延遲關門，但未同意永久改動。

options.en: She has decided that the existing closing time works best for working families.
options.zh: 她已認定現行關門時間最能配合在職家庭。

listening.explanationZh: 聽取理由後可能較不強硬，但「可能」不等於已批准。

reply.promptEn: How might the head teacher respond after hearing the families’ reasons?
reply.promptZh: （聽過家庭提出的理由後，校長可能怎樣回應？）

options.en: She may become more open to a trial period.
options.zh: 她可能更願意考慮試行一段時間。

options.en: She could ask for more details before deciding.
options.zh: 她可以要求更多資料才作決定。

options.en: She may soften her stance on the closing time.
options.zh: 她可能會放鬆對關門時間的原有立場。

options.en: She might consider one later evening each week.
options.zh: 她可能考慮每週有一晚延遲關門。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都是合理的可能回應；金句明確表達立場變得較不強硬。

scene.promptZh: 住戶代表原本反對在大廈設單車停泊處；看過不阻塞通道的設計後，願意討論試行三個月，但尚未表態支持。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The representative has softened her stance enough to discuss a trial.
options.zh: 代表的立場已有所放鬆，願意討論試行安排。

options.en: The representative has given unconditional final approval.
options.zh: 代表已無條件作出最後批准。

options.en: She has offered a different rack location without discussing a trial.
options.zh: 她沒有討論試行安排，只提出另一個停泊處位置。

scene.explanationZh: 願意討論試行顯示態度變得較開放，卻不等於已全盤支持。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個情況最不能證明 someone has softened their stance？

options.en: A member who once rejected every proposal now considers a short trial.
options.zh: 原本拒絕所有提案的成員現在願意考慮短期試行。

options.en: A leader listens to new evidence and becomes less opposed.
options.zh: 領袖聽取新證據後不再那麼反對。

options.en: A manager repeats the same absolute refusal without considering any new facts.
options.zh: 經理沒有考慮新資料，只重複原本的絕對拒絕。

contrast.explanationZh: 沒有任何態度或判斷變化，不能說立場有所放鬆。

dialogue.promptZh: 同事問：「委員聽了居民的交通數據後，是不是已支持新路線？」你知道他只答應再開一次會。哪句最準確？

options.en: He has softened his stance enough to meet again, but he has not endorsed the route.
options.zh: 他的立場已放鬆到願意再開會，但尚未支持這條路線。

options.en: He agreed to another meeting to examine the figures.
options.zh: 他同意再開會審視數據。

options.en: We should wait for his formal decision before announcing support.
options.zh: 在宣布他支持前，我們應等候正式決定。

dialogue.explanationZh: 金句同時指出態度轉變與尚未批准的界線。

speaking.en: After seeing the revised plan, the chair softened her stance but requested another review.
speaking.zh: 看過修訂方案後，主席放鬆了原有立場，但要求再次檢視。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說明立場如何有限度地改變。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：體育會主席原本堅持所有課程費用一律不退。家長出示因重傷而無法上課的證明後，主席願意討論特殊情況，但尚未改規章。用一至兩句英文描述她的態度。
writing.selfCheckZh: 說明她願意考慮例外及仍未作正式決定；不要寫成規章已經修改。

examples.en: The chair softened her stance after seeing the injury evidence and agreed to discuss a limited exception.
examples.zh: 主席看過受傷證明後放鬆原有立場，同意討論有限度例外。

examples.en: Her stance may soften further if the club reviews similar cases, but its refund rule has not changed yet.
examples.zh: 若體育會再檢視同類個案，她的立場可能進一步放鬆，但退款規章尚未改動。

takeaways.en: The council softened its stance after residents presented a workable alternative.
takeaways.zh: 居民提出可行替代方案後，議會的立場有所放鬆。

takeaways.en: Their stance may soften with more evidence, but agreement is not guaranteed.
takeaways.zh: 有更多證據後，他們的立場可能放鬆，但不保證會同意。

brief.meaningEn: Lose practical force or effectiveness when a warning, lesson or rule is not followed through.
brief.meaningZh: 警告、教訓或規則因缺乏後續行動而失去實際作用。
brief.grammar: Use a warning, lesson, consequence or rule as the subject of lose its teeth; plural subjects take their teeth.
brief.register: Discussion of follow-through, discipline and practical impact.
brief.boundaryZh: 這裏的「牙齒」是效力的比喻，不是實際牙齒，也不表示法例文字必然已改動。
brief.misconceptionZh: 只有宣布規則而沒有執行，可能使它失去作用；不能只憑規則存在就認定它有效。
brief.outcomeZh: 能說明缺乏跟進如何削弱警告或規則的效力，並自然使用比喻。

sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 112, row 7; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: Without follow-through, the lesson can lose its teeth.
sources.expression: the lesson can lose its teeth

listening.en: The chess club announced that missing three sessions would trigger a warning, but nobody recorded absences. Soon the rule began to lose its teeth.
listening.zh: 象棋學會宣布缺席三次會受警告，但沒有人記錄缺席；這項規則很快開始失去約束力。
listening.promptZh: 這項出席規則發生了甚麼變化？

options.en: It became less effective because no one kept track of absences.
options.zh: 因為沒有人記錄缺席，它變得較沒有作用。

options.en: The club replaced the rule with a new written penalty.
options.zh: 學會用一項新的書面懲罰取代原有規則。

options.en: Fewer members missed sessions after the rule was announced.
options.zh: 規則公布後，缺席的會員減少了。

options.en: Members now know exactly who has received three warnings.
options.zh: 會員現在清楚知道誰已收到三次警告。

listening.explanationZh: 沒有記錄和跟進會削弱規則效力，卻不等於規則已正式刪除。

reply.promptEn: What happens to the attendance rule when missed sessions are never recorded?
reply.promptZh: （如果從不記錄缺席，出席規則會怎樣？）

options.en: Members may stop taking the warning seriously.
options.zh: 會員可能不再認真看待警告。

options.en: The rule loses its teeth without any follow-through.
options.zh: 沒有後續跟進，這項規則便失去實際約束力。

options.en: The club cannot show who has missed three sessions.
options.zh: 學會無法指出誰缺席了三次。

options.en: Its stated consequence becomes harder to apply fairly.
options.zh: 規則訂明的後果變得更難公平執行。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都描述沒有記錄的後果；金句用本課比喻概括效力流失。

scene.promptZh: 博物館貼出禁止閃光燈的告示，但職員每次看見閃光都不處理；參觀者逐漸不再理會告示。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The no-flash rule is losing its teeth because nobody follows it up.
options.zh: 因為沒有人跟進，禁止閃光燈的規則正失去約束力。

options.en: The museum has officially withdrawn every photography restriction.
options.zh: 博物館已正式撤銷所有攝影限制。

options.en: The staff are considering a clearer sign rather than checking breaches.
options.zh: 職員正考慮換用更清楚的告示，卻仍未查核違規情況。

scene.explanationZh: 告示仍在，卻因沒有執行而逐漸失效；不能說規則已正式撤銷。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個情況最不支持「the warning loses its teeth」？

options.en: A warning is repeated, but the promised follow-up never happens.
options.zh: 警告反覆出現，但承諾的跟進從未實行。

options.en: Staff check every report and consistently apply the stated consequence.
options.zh: 職員查核每宗報告，並一致執行已說明的後果。

options.en: People realise that nobody checks whether the rule is followed.
options.zh: 大家發現沒有人檢查規則有否被遵守。

contrast.explanationZh: 若職員一致跟進並執行，便沒有足夠理由說警告失去效力。

dialogue.promptZh: 同事說：「我們已提醒過大家遲交器材的後果，為何仍有人不理會？」你知道沒有人核對歸還紀錄。哪句最完整？

options.en: The warning has lost its teeth because we never check the return log; we should start following it up.
options.zh: 我們從不核對歸還紀錄，警告已失去作用；應開始跟進。

options.en: We can ask someone to check the return log each week.
options.zh: 我們可請人每週核對歸還紀錄。

options.en: The reminder might need a clearer deadline.
options.zh: 提醒可能需要更清楚的截止時間。

dialogue.explanationZh: 金句指出缺乏跟進是警告失效的原因，亦提出改善方向。

speaking.en: Without regular checks, the equipment rule may lose its teeth even if the sign remains.
speaking.zh: 即使告示仍在，若沒有定期檢查，器材規則也可能失去約束力。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說明甚麼令一項規則變得無力。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：社區回收活動要求檔主分類廢物，但主辦方從不檢查分類結果，也不回應違規情況。用一至兩句英文說明這項要求可能怎樣失效，以及可做甚麼跟進。
writing.selfCheckZh: 寫出缺乏檢查與效力減弱之間的關係；不要說規則已正式取消。

examples.en: The sorting requirement may lose its teeth if organisers never check the bins or respond to mistakes; they should inspect the bins each week.
examples.zh: 若主辦方從不檢查回收箱或回應分類錯誤，分類要求可能失去作用；他們應每週檢查回收箱。

examples.en: Without regular bin checks, the recycling rule could lose its teeth; the team should give vendors clear feedback.
examples.zh: 若沒有定期檢查回收箱，回收規則可能失去約束力；團隊應給檔主清楚回饋。

takeaways.en: A safety warning can lose its teeth when the promised inspection never happens.
takeaways.zh: 若承諾的檢查從未進行，安全警告便可能失去作用。

takeaways.en: The club’s code lost its teeth after leaders stopped responding to repeated breaches.
takeaways.zh: 領導人停止回應一再違規後，社團守則失去了約束力。

brief.meaningEn: Resolve a practical problem or disagreement; in the future tense it can be a promise rather than a completed fix.
brief.meaningZh: 處理並解決實際問題或分歧；用將來式時只是承諾，未必已解決。
brief.grammar: Sort it out is a separable phrasal verb with it between sort and out; tense signals whether resolution is planned or complete.
brief.register: Everyday speech about plans, mix-ups and practical problems.
brief.boundaryZh: 說「we will sort it out」不代表已找到方案；若再加 somehow，語氣可能顯得欠具體。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要把日後處理的承諾當成問題已解決的證據，亦不要把 sort it out 解作把物件分類。
brief.outcomeZh: 能用本課片語提出處理問題的承諾，並交代下一步及未解決狀態。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 116, row 10; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: Without a schedule, we are left saying we'll sort it out somehow.

listening.en: Two groups were booked into the same meeting room. The organiser said, “We will sort it out after checking both groups’ times,” but neither group had moved yet.
listening.zh: 兩組人獲安排使用同一會議室。主辦者說：「查核兩組人的時間後，我們會處理好。」但當時兩組都尚未改地方。
listening.promptZh: 主辦者這句話表示甚麼？

options.en: They intend to resolve the booking clash after checking the times.
options.zh: 他們打算查核時間後處理預約衝突。

options.en: The organiser had already assigned both groups separate rooms.
options.zh: 主辦者已分別為兩組人安排不同房間。

options.en: The organiser asked the groups to resolve the clash without help.
options.zh: 主辦者要求兩組人自行解決衝突。

options.en: The organiser was making a new schedule for later bookings only.
options.zh: 主辦者只是在為日後預約制定新時間表。

listening.explanationZh: 這是未來處理問題的承諾；當時仍未完成換房安排。

reply.promptEn: How could the organiser handle the double booking?
reply.promptZh: （主辦者可以怎樣處理重複預約？）

options.en: She could check both groups’ requested times.
options.zh: 她可以核對兩組人要求的時間。

options.en: She could contact the room manager today.
options.zh: 她今天可以聯絡房間管理員。

options.en: She could sort it out after confirming which room is free.
options.zh: 確認哪間房有空後，她可以把問題處理好。

options.en: She could send each group an updated room number.
options.zh: 她可以向兩組人發送更新後的房間號碼。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都可描述處理方法；金句使用本課片語，仍是將來安排。

scene.promptZh: 兩份活動訂單都寫了同一批椅子；義工表示會先打電話給倉庫核對數量，再通知兩組人，目前尚未確認。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The volunteers will sort it out after checking the warehouse order.
options.zh: 義工查核倉庫訂單後會把問題處理好。

options.en: The chairs have already been delivered to both groups.
options.zh: 椅子已分別送到兩組人手上。

options.en: The volunteers will offer more chairs without checking the duplicate order.
options.zh: 義工會提供更多椅子，卻不會查核重複訂單。

scene.explanationZh: 核對訂單是即將採取的步驟，不代表重複訂單已獲處理。

contrast.promptZh: 哪句把「we will sort it out」誤當成已完成的事？

options.en: We still need to check the booking record before promising a room.
options.zh: 承諾提供房間前，我們仍要查核預約紀錄。

options.en: Because someone said “we will sort it out”, the room clash must already be fixed.
options.zh: 因為有人說「我們會處理好」，房間衝突一定已經解決。

options.en: The team has promised a solution but has not confirmed it yet.
options.zh: 團隊承諾會解決，但尚未確認安排。

contrast.explanationZh: 將來式表達承諾，不足以證明衝突已解決。

dialogue.promptZh: 同事問：「兩組人都要同一部投影機，現在有決定嗎？」你正準備查用量時間表。哪句最合適？

options.en: Not yet; let us check the timetable and sort it out before we notify either group.
options.zh: 還沒有；我們先查時間表，再處理好這件事，然後通知兩組人。

options.en: We can compare the two groups’ booked times first.
options.zh: 我們可以先比較兩組人預約的時間。

options.en: I will tell both groups that the decision is still pending.
options.zh: 我會告訴兩組人，決定仍待確認。

dialogue.explanationZh: 金句坦白指出尚未解決，並提出查核時間表這個具體下一步。

speaking.en: We have not resolved the clash yet, but we can sort it out after checking the schedule.
speaking.zh: 我們尚未解決衝突，但可在查核時間表後處理好。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說出尚未完成的處理安排。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：劇團發現兩組演員領了同一套戲服標籤。服裝主任會先核對清單，再重新貼標，今晚才通知演員。用一至兩句英文說明目前問題與處理計劃。
writing.selfCheckZh: 清楚說明尚未處理完成及具體下一步；不要把承諾寫成已完成。

examples.en: The costume labels are mixed up, but the manager will sort it out by checking the list before calling the actors.
examples.zh: 戲服標籤弄混了，但主任會先核對清單，再聯絡演員處理好問題。

examples.en: We have not fixed the duplicate labels yet; we will sort it out tonight after comparing the two costume lists.
examples.zh: 我們尚未處理好重複標籤；今晚會比較兩份戲服清單，然後解決。

takeaways.en: If the forms conflict, we will sort it out after checking the original requests.
takeaways.zh: 若表格資料互相矛盾，我們會查核原始申請後處理好。

takeaways.zh: 團隊與供應商確認兩個送貨日期後，把問題處理好了。

brief.meaningEn: A concrete goal that guides effort and lets people gauge progress.
brief.meaningZh: 可引導努力及衡量進度的具體目標。
brief.grammar: Give someone something to aim at commonly pairs a plan or target with the people it helps; at is figurative, not literal shooting.
brief.boundaryZh: 強調目標夠清楚可供努力，不暗示目標一定比以前更高，也不保證能達成。
brief.misconceptionZh: 空泛地說「做得更好」未必提供可追的具體目標；本課亦不是向物件投擲。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出一項計劃如何提供具體目標，並區分目標與已達成的結果。

sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 119, row 3; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: A career plan gives graduates something to aim at.

listening.en: The swimming club set a goal of forty pool lengths by June. The number gives beginners something to aim at, though no one has reached it yet.
listening.zh: 游泳會訂下六月前游畢泳池四十趟單程的目標；這數字讓初學者有明確目標可追，雖然尚未有人達成。
listening.promptZh: 四十趟單程的數字有甚麼作用？

options.en: It gives beginners a concrete target for their practice.
options.zh: 它為初學者提供具體的練習目標。

options.en: Forty pool lengths was the beginners’ average last month.
options.zh: 四十趟單程是初學者上月游畢的平均數。

options.en: The figure records how many pool lengths one beginner has already completed.
options.zh: 這數字記錄一名初學者目前已游畢多少趟單程。

options.en: The club has raised the target above last season’s level.
options.zh: 游泳會把目標提高至高於上季的水平。

listening.explanationZh: 數字提供可追求的目標，不表示會員已達成或需要破紀錄。

reply.promptEn: What does the club’s goal of forty pool lengths give beginners?
reply.promptZh: （游泳會訂下游畢泳池四十趟單程的目標，對初學者有甚麼幫助？）

options.en: It tells them what result they are working towards.
options.zh: 它告訴初學者正在努力爭取甚麼成果。

options.en: It gives them something to aim at during practice.
options.zh: 它讓他們在練習時有明確目標可追。

options.en: It lets them measure how close they are to the target.
options.zh: 它讓他們衡量自己離目標還有多遠。

options.en: It helps them plan their training across several weeks.
options.zh: 它幫助他們安排幾週的訓練。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都描述明確數字的用途；金句使用本課比喻。

scene.promptZh: 食物銀行義工決定月底前包好一百個物資箱，目前只完成三十個。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The hundred-box goal gives the volunteers something to aim at.
options.zh: 一百箱的目標讓義工有明確方向可努力。

options.en: The hundred-box figure records what volunteers packed last month.
options.zh: 一百箱是義工上月已包好的數目。

options.en: The target sets the exact number each volunteer must pack today.
options.zh: 這項目標訂明每名義工今天必須包好的確切箱數。

scene.explanationZh: 一百箱是清楚的目標，三十箱是目前進度；目標並不保證完成。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個說法最缺乏 something to aim at 所需的具體目標？

options.en: The choir wants to learn three new songs by Friday.
options.zh: 合唱團想在星期五前學會三首新歌。

options.en: The team hopes to “do better someday” but sets no measure or deadline.
options.zh: 團隊只希望「有天做得更好」，卻沒有訂下標準或期限。

options.en: The class plans to finish four practice essays this month.
options.zh: 全班計劃本月完成四篇練習文章。

contrast.explanationZh: 沒有可辨認的標準或期限，難以成為清楚的追求目標。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「這個新計劃怎樣幫助讀書會？它寫明每週讀完二十頁。」你怎樣回答最貼切？

options.en: The weekly page target gives members something to aim at, even if they do not always reach it.
options.zh: 每週的頁數目標讓會員有明確方向可努力，即使未必次次做到。

options.en: Members can compare their reading with the weekly page target.
options.zh: 會員可以對照每週的頁數目標檢視進度。

options.en: The plan makes it easier to choose how much to read each day.
options.zh: 這項計劃令會員較易安排每天的閱讀量。

dialogue.explanationZh: 金句指出二十頁提供努力方向，沒有把目標當成已完成的事。

speaking.en: The small weekly target gave the new members something to aim at without guaranteeing success.
speaking.zh: 每週的小目標讓新會員有明確方向可努力，卻不保證成功。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說出具體目標如何引導努力。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：動物收容所希望在學期結束前募得五百元，用來購買冬季毛毯。義工目前募得一百二十元。用一至兩句英文說明金額目標的作用，並區分目標與進度。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出具體金額和目前已募得的款項；不要把希望寫成已達標。

examples.en: The $500 target gives volunteers something to aim at, though they have raised only $120 for winter blankets so far.
examples.zh: 五百元的目標讓義工有明確方向可努力，但他們至今只為冬季毛毯募得一百二十元。

examples.en: The shelter has raised $120 towards its $500 goal; that clear target gives volunteers something to aim at before term ends.
examples.zh: 收容所目前已募得一百二十元，朝五百元目標努力；這個明確目標讓義工在學期結束前有方向可追。

takeaways.en: A clear delivery date gives the team something to aim at during the project.
takeaways.zh: 清楚的交付日期讓團隊在項目期間有明確目標可追。

takeaways.en: The score target gave the players something to aim at, not proof they had reached it.
takeaways.zh: 得分目標讓球員有明確方向可努力，卻不能證明他們已達標。

brief.meaningEn: Make little or no meaningful progress despite activity or effort.
brief.meaningZh: 雖然一直忙碌或努力，卻沒有取得實質進展。
brief.grammar: Get anywhere is figurative progress; negative forms such as are not getting anywhere or without getting anywhere carry the target sense.
brief.register: Everyday reflection on work, planning and stalled projects.
brief.boundaryZh: 本課說的是進展，不是實際行程；忙碌但欠方向不等於懶惰或完全沒有做事。
brief.misconceptionZh: 活動數量多不一定代表朝目標邁進；應指出哪些關鍵成果仍未出現。
brief.outcomeZh: 能分辨忙碌與實質進展，並描述缺乏方向如何令工作停滯。

sources.sentence: He was busy without really getting anywhere until he chose a direction.

listening.en: The exhibition team held four planning meetings and changed the poster twice, but it still had no venue. “We are not getting anywhere,” the leader said.
listening.zh: 展覽團隊開了四次策劃會，又兩次改動海報，但仍未找到場地。負責人說：「我們沒有實質進展。」

options.en: The team has been active but has not secured a key requirement.
options.zh: 團隊一直有工作，卻未確定一項關鍵安排。

options.en: The main problem is that the team dislikes its poster design.
options.zh: 主要問題是團隊不喜歡海報設計。

options.en: A venue has been confirmed, but the poster still needs work.
options.zh: 場地已經確定，但海報仍需修改。

options.en: The poster changes show that the key planning decision is complete.
options.zh: 海報的改動表明關鍵的策劃決定已完成。

listening.explanationZh: 開會和改海報是活動，但場地仍未確定，所以核心籌備沒有進展。

reply.promptEn: How is the exhibition planning going despite all the meetings?
reply.promptZh: （雖然開了多次會，展覽籌備進展如何？）

options.en: The team is still missing a confirmed venue.
options.zh: 團隊仍未確定場地。

options.en: They are not getting anywhere on the venue decision.
options.zh: 他們在場地決定上仍沒有實質進展。

options.en: Several discussions have ended without a final booking.
options.zh: 幾次討論結束後仍沒有完成預約。

options.en: The main practical decision remains unresolved.
options.zh: 最主要的實際決定仍未解決。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都指出場地尚未落實；金句用本課比喻描述停滯。

scene.promptZh: 應用程式團隊一週內反覆改按鈕顏色，卻始終沒有修好讓使用者無法登入的問題。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The team is busy without getting anywhere on the login problem.
options.zh: 團隊雖然忙碌，卻沒有在登入問題上取得進展。

options.en: The new button colours may make the screen easier to read.
options.zh: 新的按鈕顏色可能令畫面更易閱讀。

options.en: The login failure appears to affect only new users.
options.zh: 登入故障似乎只影響新使用者。

scene.explanationZh: 改顏色沒有解決核心登入障礙；忙碌不等於目標有進展。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個情況最不能稱為 not getting anywhere？

options.en: A group revises its title repeatedly but never chooses a venue.
options.zh: 小組反覆修改標題，卻始終未選定場地。

options.en: A team completes a working prototype and tests it with users.
options.zh: 團隊完成可運作的原型，並請使用者測試。

options.en: Workers hold daily meetings while the essential repair remains untouched.
options.zh: 員工每天開會，關鍵維修卻一直沒有動工。

contrast.explanationZh: 完成並測試可運作的原型，是可見的實質進展。

dialogue.promptZh: 同事說：「我們很忙，為甚麼截止日期仍愈來愈近？」你知道團隊一直討論標誌，卻沒有完成訂票頁。哪句最合適？

options.en: We are not getting anywhere on the booking page because we keep returning to the logo; let us finish the form first.
options.zh: 我們不斷回頭討論標誌，訂票頁卻沒有實質進展；先完成表格吧。

options.en: We can pause the logo debate and assign someone to the form.
options.zh: 我們可暫停標誌討論，指派一人處理表格。

options.en: The booking page is still the key unfinished task.
options.zh: 訂票頁仍是最重要的未完成工作。

dialogue.explanationZh: 金句區分忙碌與核心工作停滯，並提出具體下一步。

speaking.en: They were not getting anywhere with the booking form until they agreed on one design.
speaking.zh: 他們的訂票表格一直沒有進展，直到大家同意一個設計。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說明哪項核心工作停滯。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：學校戲劇組已討論三次服裝顏色，卻一直未量度演員尺碼或訂購布料。演出日期將近。用一至兩句英文描述忙碌與進展之間的落差，並提出下一步。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出有做過甚麼及哪項關鍵工作仍未開始；不要指責大家懶惰。

examples.en: The drama group is not getting anywhere on costumes: it keeps debating colours but has not measured the actors; it should measure the cast today.
examples.zh: 戲劇組在服裝工作上沒有實質進展：他們不斷討論顏色，卻尚未量度演員尺碼；今天應量度演員。

examples.en: They have held three meetings without getting anywhere on the fabric order, so someone should measure the cast today.
examples.zh: 他們開了三次會，布料訂購仍沒有進展，因此今天應先量度演員尺碼。

glossary.en: someone should measure the cast today
glossary.zh: 今天應有人量度演員尺碼

takeaways.en: The volunteers are not getting anywhere with the timetable until someone confirms the venue.
takeaways.zh: 在有人確認場地前，義工在時間表上沒有實質進展。

takeaways.en: We worked all morning without really getting anywhere because the key decision was missing.
takeaways.zh: 我們忙了整個上午，卻因缺乏關鍵決定而沒有實質進展。

brief.meaningEn: An additional difficulty that someone feels they must deal with before moving on.
brief.meaningZh: 又一項要先處理才能繼續前進的困難。
brief.grammar: Use feel/seem like another hurdle to get over when the burden is someone’s assessment; another signals an additional obstacle, not the first one.
brief.register: Everyday planning, school or work after earlier tasks have already been handled.
brief.boundaryZh: 可說當事人覺得難辦；別把主觀感受寫成必然失敗。
brief.misconceptionZh: another 不等於 at the first hurdle，也不表示這件事永遠無法完成。
brief.outcomeZh: 能說出新增的障礙、此前已完成的工作，以及語氣上的不確定性。

sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 130, row 3; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: After a long shift, cooking seemed like another hurdle to get over.

listening.promptZh: 為何小組把安全計劃看成一道難關？

options.en: It added work after they thought the venue arrangements were settled.
options.zh: 他們原以為場地安排已妥當，現在卻要多做一項工作。

options.en: It made them check whether the hall could still meet the event’s needs.
options.zh: 它讓他們核對禮堂是否仍符合活動需要。

options.en: It gave them more information about possible risks at the event.
options.zh: 它讓他們更了解活動可能出現的風險。

options.en: It helped them decide which volunteers would welcome visitors.
options.zh: 它幫他們決定哪些義工負責迎接訪客。

listening.explanationZh: 他們先前已完成場地預約，新增的安全計劃讓進度多了一項要處理的要求；其他說法只推測計劃可能帶來的附帶作用。
listening.en: The student group had booked the hall, but the school office then requested a new safety plan. To them, it felt like another hurdle to get over.
listening.zh: 學生小組已訂好禮堂，但其後校方要求補交新的安全計劃；對他們來說，這似乎又是一道要克服的難關。

reply.promptZh: （新增的翻譯檢查對指南推出有甚麼影響？）

options.en: It adds a review stage before the guide can be released.
options.zh: 指南推出前要多經過一道審核程序。

options.en: It may push the release date back while the wording is checked.
options.zh: 核對措辭期間，推出日期可能要延後。

options.en: It feels like another hurdle to get over before we can publish.
options.zh: 在我們能出版前，這感覺又是一道要克服的難關。

options.en: It gives us a chance to correct unclear phrases before launch.
options.zh: 它讓我們有機會在推出前修改含糊的措辭。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均回應新增檢查的影響；金句以本課比喻表達團隊對額外程序的感受。
reply.promptEn: How does the extra translation check affect the guide launch?

scene.promptZh: 應徵者已交齊作品集，又收到額外的身分核實要求。哪句最貼切表達她此刻的感受？

options.en: The new verification feels like another hurdle to get over before the interview.
options.zh: 新增核實要求讓她覺得面試前又多了一道要克服的難關。

options.en: The extra check may delay when she can confirm the interview.
options.zh: 額外檢查可能延遲她確認面試的時間。

options.en: Her portfolio may still need a separate review by the employer.
options.zh: 僱主可能仍需另行審閱她的作品集。

scene.explanationZh: 她已完成一項申請工作，又遇上額外要求；另兩句只是可能的程序後果，沒有表達主觀難關。

contrast.promptZh: 哪句最清楚顯示 another hurdle 而非第一項障礙？

options.en: The team finished the permit forms, then learned it needed a separate insurance certificate.
options.zh: 團隊完成許可表格後，才知道還要另交保險證明。

options.en: The team has just received the project brief and has not begun any requirements.
options.zh: 團隊才剛收到計劃簡介，尚未開始處理任何要求。

options.en: The team has already cleared several requirements and is waiting for the final decision.
options.zh: 團隊已完成幾項要求，正等待最後決定。

contrast.explanationZh: 先完成許可表格、後來又新增保險證明，才明確是「另一道」障礙；等待結果本身未必是新增難關。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「我們已預訂車輛，現在又要申請臨時停車許可，怎麼辦？」哪句最能同時回應新要求和實際下一步？

options.en: The permit feels like another hurdle to get over; let us ask the office what documents it needs.
options.zh: 許可申請感覺又是一道難關；我們問問辦事處需要甚麼文件吧。

options.en: We can ask the office what documents the permit needs.
options.zh: 我們可以問辦事處申請許可需要甚麼文件。

options.en: The parking rules may affect where the vehicle can stop.
options.zh: 停車規則可能影響車輛可在哪裏停泊。

dialogue.explanationZh: 金句承認新增要求帶來的負擔，同時提出可行查詢；另外兩句只談其中一方面。

speaking.en: After arranging the speakers, the missing caption file felt like another hurdle to get over.
speaking.zh: 安排好講者後，缺少字幕檔感覺又成了一道要克服的難關。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說出新增的障礙。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：社區電影放映會已借好場地、確認影片，但主辦者發現還要取得無障礙字幕檔。用一至兩句英文說明新增難題和下一步；保留「感覺上」而非斷言無法舉辦。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出此前已完成甚麼、新要求是甚麼，以及可以採取的下一步；不要說活動必然取消。

examples.en: The venue is booked, but getting a caption file feels like another hurdle to get over; we can ask the distributor for one.
examples.zh: 場地已訂好，但取得字幕檔感覺又是一道要克服的難關；我們可以向發行商索取。

examples.en: With the film confirmed, the caption request seems like another hurdle to get over, so the organisers will contact the distributor today.
examples.zh: 影片已確認，字幕要求似乎又是一道難關，因此主辦者今天會聯絡發行商。

takeaways.en: After the budget was approved, the new insurance form felt like another hurdle to get over.
takeaways.zh: 預算獲批後，新增的保險表格感覺又成了一道要克服的難關。

takeaways.en: Another hurdle to get over may delay the launch, but it does not mean the launch is impossible.
takeaways.zh: 又一道難關可能令推出時間延後，但不等於計劃無法推出。

brief.meaningEn: Natural mental ability before experience, habits or practice have shaped how it is used.
brief.meaningZh: 尚未經經驗、習慣或練習磨練的天生思考能力。
brief.grammar: Raw modifies intelligence as unrefined potential; it does not mean rude behaviour or an unchangeable intelligence score.
brief.register: Education, work and skill development when comparing ability with training.
brief.boundaryZh: 天資可幫助起步，但是否取得成果也受練習、方法和環境影響。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不能說有天資的人不需努力，也不能因此貶低天資。
brief.outcomeZh: 能把起步能力與後天培養分開描述。

sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 150, row 6; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: Steady work can matter more than raw intelligence.

listening.promptZh: 甚麼讓伊瑪妮的證明更完整？

options.en: Checking the missing steps carefully after spotting the pattern.
options.zh: 看出規律後，仔細核對原本漏掉的步驟。

options.en: Remembering a theorem she had used in an earlier exercise.
options.zh: 想起她在之前練習用過的定理。

options.en: Discussing her first idea with another student after class.
options.zh: 課後與另一位學生討論最初的想法。

options.en: Writing a clearer introduction before submitting the proof.
options.zh: 交證明前把引言寫得更清楚。

listening.explanationZh: 天資讓她迅速看出規律，但補足證明靠核對；其他做法可能有幫助，卻不是講者指出的關鍵。
listening.en: Imani could spot a mathematical pattern quickly, but her first proof left out key steps. Her raw intelligence helped her begin; careful checking made the argument sound.
listening.zh: 伊瑪妮很快看出數學規律，但第一版證明漏了關鍵步驟；她的天資幫她起步，細心檢查才令論證完整。

reply.promptZh: （甚麼幫助瑪雅迅速學會這項程式挑戰？）

options.en: She already understood some of the mathematical ideas behind it.
options.zh: 她原本就理解其中部分數學概念。

options.en: Her raw intelligence helped her grasp the pattern, and practice helped her apply it.
options.zh: 她的天資幫她掌握規律，練習則幫她運用。

options.en: She tested her code against several examples and fixed mistakes.
options.zh: 她用幾個例子測試程式並修正錯誤。

options.en: A mentor showed her how to break the task into smaller parts.
options.zh: 導師教她把任務拆成較小部分。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都能說明學習的助力；金句把天資與練習的不同作用一併交代。
reply.promptEn: What helped Maya learn the coding challenge so quickly?

scene.promptZh: 一名新棋手很快看出攻勢，卻常忽略後續防守；教練安排她逐局覆盤。哪句最準確？

options.en: Raw intelligence may help her spot moves, while reviewing games can strengthen her judgement.
options.zh: 天資可幫她看出走法，覆盤則能加強判斷。

options.en: Her quick tactical vision may matter more than reviewing defensive mistakes.
options.zh: 她迅速看出戰術的能力或許比檢討防守失誤更重要。

options.en: The coach’s reviews will mainly improve her opening moves.
options.zh: 教練安排的覆盤主要會改善她的開局走法。

scene.explanationZh: 快速看出攻勢和忽略防守可同時存在；覆盤有助運用天資，不能只重攻勢或假設覆盤主要改善開局。

contrast.promptZh: 哪句把 raw intelligence 的意思說得過於絕對？

options.en: It can be a useful starting point for learning a difficult skill.
options.zh: 它可以是學習困難技能的一個有利起點。

options.en: It guarantees expert performance without experience or correction.
options.zh: 即使沒有經驗或修正，它也保證專家級表現。

options.en: It may become more effective when paired with good study habits.
options.zh: 配合良好的學習習慣，天資可能發揮得更好。

contrast.explanationZh: 天資不保證不經磨練便有專家表現；它和習慣、練習可以互相配合。

dialogue.promptZh: 同學說：「他第一次試做便找到解題方向，但解說還不清楚。」你如何公允地回應？

options.en: His raw intelligence gave him a quick start, but he still needs to practise explaining each step.
options.zh: 他的天資讓他迅速起步，但仍需練習清楚解釋每一步。

options.en: He saw a possible solution early, so we could ask him to explain it again.
options.zh: 他很早看出一種可能解法，我們可以請他再解釋一次。

options.en: Working through the reasoning aloud may help him make the idea clearer.
options.zh: 把推理過程說出來，可能幫他把想法講得更清楚。

dialogue.explanationZh: 金句肯定他的起步能力，也指出需要磨練的部分；沒有把天資視為萬能。

speaking.en: Raw intelligence helped her notice the pattern, but repeated tests made her conclusion reliable.
speaking.zh: 天資幫她留意到規律，但反覆測試才令結論可靠。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說明天資與練習各起甚麼作用。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：學校機械人隊有位新成員很快想出導航方法，但測試時常漏看障礙物。隊友帶他做多輪測試。用一至兩句英文平衡描述他的天資和後續練習。
writing.selfCheckZh: 既肯定快速想法，也說明測試如何改善成果；不要斷言天資沒有用或保證成功。

examples.en: His raw intelligence gave the robot team an early idea, while repeated trials helped them spot obstacles.
examples.zh: 他的天資讓機械人隊很早有了想法，而反覆測試幫他們發現障礙物。

examples.en: Raw intelligence helped him design a route quickly, but checking the sensors made the robot move more safely.
examples.zh: 天資幫他迅速設計路線，但檢查感應器才令機械人行動更安全。

takeaways.en: Raw intelligence gave the apprentice a promising start, but feedback sharpened her method.
takeaways.zh: 天資令學徒有個好開始，但回饋讓她的方法更成熟。

takeaways.en: The team valued raw intelligence without mistaking it for finished expertise.
takeaways.zh: 團隊重視天資，卻沒有把它誤當成已磨練完成的專業能力。

lessons.titleZh: 本地慈善界的活動網絡

brief.meaningEn: The network of organisations, people and activities in a local field, here charitable work.
brief.meaningZh: 某地一個領域的團體、人員及活動網絡；本課以慈善工作為例。
brief.grammar: In the local charity scene, scene names an active social sector; other fields can form the X scene pattern when context supports it.
brief.register: Community reporting, volunteering and discussion of a local sector.
brief.boundaryZh: scene 指整個界別的活動情況，不等於單一活動或舞台背景。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不能只憑一間機構存在，就斷言全市慈善網絡很活躍。
brief.outcomeZh: 能用本課表達概括多個組織之間的活動與連繫。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 172, row 2; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: The city has an active charity scene.

listening.promptZh: 講者說新義工現在較容易做甚麼？

options.en: Find a suitable group and see when it needs help.
options.zh: 找到合適團體，並了解它何時需要幫忙。

options.en: Compare how much each organisation spends on volunteer training.
options.zh: 比較各機構在義工培訓上的開支。

options.en: See which group has the shortest waiting list for help.
options.zh: 查看哪個團體的求助輪候名單最短。

options.en: Find out how the different groups make funding decisions.
options.zh: 了解不同團體如何作出資助決定。

listening.explanationZh: 共用日程與不同團體的合作，讓新義工較容易找到適合自己的參與方式；講者沒有提供開支、輪候或資助決策資料。
listening.en: In Harbourtown, food banks and tutoring groups now use a shared volunteer calendar. The local charity scene has become easier for newcomers to navigate.
listening.zh: 在港灣鎮，食物銀行和補習團體現在共用義工日程；新加入的人更容易了解當地慈善界的運作。

reply.promptZh: （這個地區的義工服務有甚麼轉變？）

options.en: Several groups now share training dates and sign-up information.
options.zh: 幾個團體現在共用培訓日期和報名資料。

options.en: New volunteers can compare opportunities before joining a group.
options.zh: 新義工加入團體前可以比較不同機會。

options.en: The local charity scene is more connected because groups coordinate their events.
options.zh: 各團體協調活動，令本地慈善界的活動網絡更緊密。

options.en: The town’s volunteer website lists more projects than last year.
options.zh: 市鎮的義工網站列出的計劃比去年更多。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都回應地區義工服務的變化；金句概括多個團體共同構成的慈善界網絡。
reply.promptEn: How has volunteering changed across the district?

scene.promptZh: 一個地區有多個互相合作的食物援助、長者探訪和學生導師團體，每月共用義工簡介會。哪句最完整？

options.en: The local charity scene is active and connected across several groups.
options.zh: 本地慈善界有多個團體積極活動，彼此亦有聯繫。

options.en: The monthly meeting helps new volunteers learn the schedule.
options.zh: 每月簡介會幫助新義工了解時間安排。

options.en: One group may specialise in visits to older residents.
options.zh: 其中一個團體可能專門探訪長者。

scene.explanationZh: 情境同時呈現多個團體及合作網絡，適合用 scene 概括；另兩句只描述其中一項安排。

contrast.promptZh: 哪句最不適合用來證明一個地方有活躍的 charity scene？

options.en: Several aid groups share volunteers and hold regular community events.
options.zh: 幾個援助團體共用義工，並定期舉辦社區活動。

options.en: A single office has a charity poster, but no local groups or activities are known.
options.zh: 一間辦公室貼有慈善海報，但未見任何本地團體或活動。

options.en: Different organisations run food, mentoring and housing projects in the area.
options.zh: 區內不同機構開展食物、導師和房屋項目。

contrast.explanationZh: 一張海報本身不足以顯示當地有組織網絡或持續活動。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「為甚麼這個新居民容易找到義工工作？」你知道當地多個慈善團體共用活動日程。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The local charity scene is well connected, so newcomers can see opportunities across groups.
options.zh: 本地慈善界聯繫緊密，新居民可以看到不同團體的參與機會。

options.en: The shared calendar shows when different groups need help.
options.zh: 共用日程列出不同團體何時需要幫忙。

options.en: They can ask each group which task fits their available time.
options.zh: 他們可以向各團體查詢哪項工作配合自己的時間。

dialogue.explanationZh: 金句概括網絡如何幫助新居民；另兩句只指出其中兩種具體做法。

speaking.en: The local charity scene grew more connected when groups began sharing volunteers.
speaking.zh: 不同團體開始共用義工後，本地慈善界的聯繫更緊密。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說明 scene 包括甚麼。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：一個山區市鎮有幾個青年支援、食物分享和長者探訪團體，今年開始共用培訓和招募資料。用一至兩句英文概括這個地區的慈善界變化。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出多個團體與活動網絡，不要把 scene 誤作舞台或單一機構。

examples.en: The local charity scene is becoming more connected as youth, food and elder-support groups share training.
examples.zh: 青年、食物援助和長者支援團體共用培訓，本地慈善界的聯繫逐漸更緊密。

examples.en: With a shared volunteer calendar, the charity scene now gives residents clearer ways to help different groups.
examples.zh: 有了共用義工日程，慈善界現在讓居民更清楚如何協助不同團體。

glossary.zh: 青年、食物援助和長者支援團體

takeaways.en: The local charity scene expanded when three small groups began planning together.
takeaways.zh: 三個小團體開始共同策劃後，本地慈善界的活動網絡擴大了。

takeaways.en: A busy charity scene involves people and organisations, not merely one fundraising poster.
takeaways.zh: 活躍的慈善界涉及人員與機構，不只是一張籌款海報。

brief.meaningEn: Visible to, or directly interacting with, members of the public as part of a role or service.
brief.meaningZh: 職務或服務會讓公眾看見，或直接與公眾互動。
brief.grammar: Public-facing is a hyphenated adjective before a noun or after be; contrast with back-office work.
brief.register: Workplace, charity and service descriptions of roles with direct external contact.
brief.boundaryZh: 面向公眾不等於由政府出資，亦不自動表示財務資料公開。
brief.misconceptionZh: 幕後職位可以同樣重要，只是工作對象不同。
brief.outcomeZh: 能根據實際接觸對象判斷職位是否面向公眾。

sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 172, row 5; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.

listening.promptZh: 為何蕾拉的職位屬於 public-facing？

options.en: She speaks with visitors as part of her regular duties.
options.zh: 她日常職務包括與訪客交談。

options.en: She prepares information sheets for visitors to take home.
options.zh: 她準備資料單張供訪客帶回家。

options.en: She designs the appointment timetable for the service desk.
options.zh: 她設計服務櫃檯的預約時間表。

options.en: She writes public health updates for the centre’s website.
options.zh: 她為中心網站撰寫公共健康資訊。

listening.explanationZh: 接待訪客和回答問題都涉及直接對外互動；其他工作可能面向公眾，但不是講者說明其職位的直接依據。
listening.en: At the health centre, Leila greets visitors and answers their questions, while another team handles grant reports. Her job is public-facing.
listening.zh: 在健康中心，蕾拉接待訪客並回答問題，另一團隊則處理資助報告；她的職位直接面向公眾。

reply.promptZh: （博物館的外展員每天做甚麼？）

options.en: She welcomes visiting school groups and answers their questions.
options.zh: 她迎接到訪的學校團體並解答問題。

options.en: She runs short demonstrations for families at the entrance.
options.zh: 她在入口為家庭舉行簡短示範。

options.en: She has a public-facing role, explaining exhibits directly to visitors.
options.zh: 她的職位直接面向公眾，親自向訪客講解展品。

options.en: She replies to visitors who ask about upcoming workshops.
options.zh: 她回覆訪客對即將舉行的工作坊的查詢。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都是日常對外工作；金句以本課形容詞概括她的職位性質。
reply.promptEn: What does the museum’s outreach worker do each day?

scene.promptZh: 一間動物收容所的甲組每天接待領養家庭並回答照顧問題，乙組在辦公室整理捐款收據。哪句最準確？

options.en: The adoption team has a public-facing role because it meets prospective families.
options.zh: 領養組會接觸有意領養的家庭，因此其職務直接面向公眾。

options.en: The receipt team prepares records used in the organisation’s accounts.
options.zh: 收據組準備機構帳目所需的紀錄。

options.en: Both teams contribute to the shelter’s work in different ways.
options.zh: 兩組都以不同方式支持收容所的工作。

scene.explanationZh: 甲組每天與公眾互動，最能顯示 public-facing；乙組重要但屬幕後行政。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項資料最不足以證明一個職位是 public-facing？

options.en: The worker speaks with families who visit the service desk.
options.zh: 職員與到服務櫃檯的家庭交談。

options.en: The worker is paid from a government grant but prepares internal spreadsheets only.
options.zh: 職員薪酬來自政府資助，但只整理內部試算表。

options.en: The worker hosts weekly question sessions open to residents.
options.zh: 職員每週主持居民可參加的答問會。

contrast.explanationZh: 資金來源無法證明工作會直接接觸公眾；工作內容才是判斷依據。

dialogue.promptZh: 同事說：「我們要找一位能向到訪家庭解釋領養程序的人。」你如何描述這個職位？

options.en: It is a public-facing role, so the person should be comfortable answering families’ questions.
options.zh: 這是直接面向公眾的職位，應徵者要樂於回答家庭的問題。

options.en: The person will explain the steps to families at the shelter.
options.zh: 這個人會在收容所向家庭解釋程序。

options.en: Clear answers will help visitors understand the adoption process.
options.zh: 清楚的回答有助訪客了解領養程序。

dialogue.explanationZh: 金句指出職位性質及所需能力；沒有把資助來源與對外接觸混淆。

speaking.en: Her public-facing work includes greeting visitors and answering questions at the help desk.
speaking.zh: 她直接面向公眾的工作包括在服務櫃檯接待訪客及解答問題。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再指出直接接觸公眾的工作。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：社區圖書館一名職員在服務台協助讀者找書，也回答活動報名問題；另一位同事只在辦公室編目。用一至兩句英文指出前者的職務性質，並說明理由。
writing.selfCheckZh: 以直接接觸讀者為依據，不要把 public-facing 解作由公帑支付或披露財務資料。

examples.en: The desk librarian has a public-facing role because she helps readers find books and answers event enquiries.
examples.zh: 服務台館員直接面向公眾，因為她協助讀者找書，並回答活動查詢。

examples.en: Her public-facing duties include guiding visitors through the catalogue, while her colleague handles records in the back office.
examples.zh: 她直接面向公眾的職責包括指導訪客使用目錄，另一位同事則在後台處理紀錄。

takeaways.en: The reception volunteer had a public-facing role during the open day.
takeaways.zh: 開放日當天，接待義工的職位直接面向公眾。

takeaways.en: A public-facing job involves direct contact; it need not be publicly funded.
takeaways.zh: 直接面向公眾的工作涉及對外接觸，但不一定由公帑資助。

brief.meaningEn: Initiate contact with someone, often for support, conversation or human connection.
brief.meaningZh: 主動與人聯絡，通常是為了尋求支持、交談或建立連繫。
brief.grammar: Use reach out to someone or reach out for help; contact is the action, while being understood is only a possible result.
brief.register: Everyday personal and support contexts, spoken or written.
brief.boundaryZh: 主動聯絡不保證對方即時回覆或完全理解。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不能把發訊息等同已獲理解；對方可能需要時間回應。
brief.outcomeZh: 能說明主動聯絡的對象、原因及尚未確定的結果。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 228, row 8; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: People still want to reach out and be understood.

options.en: He contacted his cousin because he wanted someone to talk to.
options.zh: 他因為想找人交談而聯絡了表親。

options.en: He planned to call his cousin but waited until the next day.
options.zh: 他打算致電表親，但等到翌日才行動。

options.en: He contacted a colleague to ask about local activities.
options.zh: 他聯絡同事，詢問本地活動。

options.en: He asked his cousin for practical advice about housing.
options.zh: 他向表親請教住屋方面的實際建議。

listening.explanationZh: reach out 指他已主動聯絡表親想交談；其他選項改變了行動時間、對象或目的。
listening.en: After moving to another city, Theo felt isolated and reached out to his cousin for a chat. He had not yet heard back, but sending the message was a first step.
listening.zh: 搬到另一個城市後，西奧感到孤單，便主動聯絡表親想聊一聊；對方尚未回覆，但他已踏出第一步。

reply.promptZh: （瑪雅在新學校感到孤單時做了甚麼？）

options.en: She sent an old friend a message asking whether they could talk.
options.zh: 她傳訊息給舊朋友，問可否聊一聊。

options.en: She reached out to her former classmate for a conversation.
options.zh: 她主動聯絡舊同學，想與對方交談。

options.en: She asked the school adviser for a time to meet.
options.zh: 她請學校輔導員安排見面時間。

options.en: She wrote to her cousin to say she was having a difficult week.
options.zh: 她寫信給表親，說自己這星期過得很辛苦。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都描述她主動尋求連繫的行動；金句用本課片語概括。
reply.promptEn: What did Maya do when she felt alone at her new school?

scene.promptZh: 一名新職員連續幾週不敢問問題，後來主動傳訊息給導師，希望討論工作上的困難；導師尚未回覆。哪句最準確？

options.en: She reached out to her mentor, though she has not received an answer yet.
options.zh: 她主動聯絡導師，但尚未收到回覆。

options.en: Her mentor may suggest a way forward once they have spoken.
options.zh: 他們談過之後，導師或許會提出下一步做法。

options.en: She may still need to arrange time to explain the problem in detail.
options.zh: 她可能仍要另約時間，詳細說明問題。

scene.explanationZh: 傳訊息本身就是主動聯絡，尚未收到回覆；其他句子只推測接下來可能發生甚麼。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種說法把 reach out 的結果說得過於肯定？

options.en: He reached out to a neighbour to ask whether she could talk.
options.zh: 他主動聯絡鄰居，問對方能否談談。

options.en: He reached out, so the neighbour must already understand exactly how he feels.
options.zh: 他已主動聯絡，因此鄰居必定已完全明白他的感受。

options.en: He can reach out now and wait for a reply before making other plans.
options.zh: 他現在可以主動聯絡，等回覆後再作其他安排。

contrast.explanationZh: 主動聯絡是行動，對方是否回覆或理解仍未確定。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「阿健最近不太說話，我想知道他是否需要有人陪。」你怎樣提出一個不替對方作保證的建議？

options.en: You could reach out to him with a short message and let him decide when to reply.
options.zh: 你可以發短訊主動聯絡他，讓他自己決定何時回覆。

options.en: You could send him a brief message saying you are available to talk.
options.zh: 你可以傳一則短訊，告訴他你願意交談。

options.en: It may help to ask whether he wants company this week.
options.zh: 你可以問他這星期是否想有人陪伴。

dialogue.explanationZh: 金句提出體貼的主動聯絡方式，也保留對方選擇與回覆的空間。

speaking.en: When she felt stuck, she reached out to a former teammate and asked if they could talk.
speaking.zh: 她感到受困時，主動聯絡一位舊隊友，問對方可否聊聊。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說出她採取的主動聯絡行動。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：一名學生轉校後想念舊朋友，但不知道對方何時有空。她打算傳簡短訊息問能否週末談談。用一至兩句英文描述她的行動，並保留回覆仍未確定。
writing.selfCheckZh: 寫出主動聯絡的對象及目的；不要斷言朋友已回覆或完全理解。

examples.en: She reached out to an old friend with a short message asking if they could talk at the weekend.
examples.zh: 她傳簡短訊息主動聯絡舊朋友，問週末能否談談。

examples.en: She can reach out and suggest a weekend call, while giving her friend time to reply.
examples.zh: 她可以主動聯絡並建議週末通話，同時讓朋友有時間回覆。

takeaways.en: The new volunteer reached out to the coordinator before the first shift.
takeaways.zh: 新義工在第一次當值前主動聯絡統籌員。

takeaways.en: Reaching out starts a conversation; it does not guarantee the other person can answer immediately.
takeaways.zh: 主動聯絡可開啟對話，但不保證對方能立即回答。

brief.meaningEn: Give a family stability, continuity or a shared point of connection.
brief.meaningZh: 為家庭帶來穩定感、延續性或共同連繫。
brief.grammar: Anchor is a stability metaphor with family as object; the thing that anchors may be a shared practice, place or person.
brief.register: Family history, community and reflection on continuity through change.
brief.boundaryZh: 有穩定依靠不等於家人永不爭執，或不會再搬遷。
brief.misconceptionZh: 錨是比喻，不是說真的用船錨固定家人。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出甚麼讓家人在變化中保持連繫，也保留限制。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 233, row 8; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: An inherited home can anchor a family.

listening.promptZh: 星期日的通話對家庭有甚麼作用？

options.en: It gives relatives a regular way to stay connected across cities.
options.zh: 它讓住在不同城市的親人定期保持聯繫。

options.en: It helps them settle practical plans for the coming week.
options.zh: 它幫助他們商定下星期的實際安排。

options.en: It gives the eldest sibling a chance to share new stories.
options.zh: 它讓長兄姊有機會分享新故事。

options.en: It lets them replace occasional visits with calls.
options.zh: 它讓他們以通話取代偶爾探訪。

listening.explanationZh: 定期通話帶來跨城市的穩定連繫；講者沒有特別提及下週安排、哪位親人說故事或是否減少探訪。
listening.en: The siblings live in three cities, yet their Sunday story call has continued for years. The call anchors the family when their schedules change.
listening.zh: 兄弟姊妹住在三個城市，但多年來每逢星期日仍會通話說故事；即使各人日程有變，這通電話也為家庭帶來穩定連繫。

reply.promptZh: （分居不同地方後，每週聚餐怎樣幫助這家人？）

options.en: It gives them a familiar time to meet and share news.
options.zh: 它給他們一個熟悉的時間見面和交換近況。

options.en: It helps younger relatives hear stories from older ones.
options.zh: 它讓年輕親人聽到長輩的故事。

options.en: The meal anchors the family by keeping a shared routine alive.
options.zh: 這頓聚餐延續共同習慣，為家庭提供穩定依靠。

options.en: It makes it easier to arrange a visit when everyone is free.
options.zh: 它讓大家有空時較容易安排見面。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都說明聚餐的幫助；金句以本課比喻概括共同習慣帶來的穩定感。
reply.promptEn: How has the weekly meal helped the family since they moved apart?

scene.promptZh: 一個家庭搬離舊社區後，仍保留每月一起製作家族食譜的習慣，藉此分享不同世代的回憶。哪句最完整？

options.en: The recipe-making routine anchors the family through their move.
options.zh: 一起寫食譜的習慣，在搬遷變化中為家庭提供穩定連繫。

options.en: The family may publish the recipes in a small booklet one day.
options.zh: 這家人或許有一天會把食譜出版成小冊子。

options.en: The recipes make it easier to remember what they cooked last month.
options.zh: 食譜讓他們更容易記得上個月煮過甚麼。

scene.explanationZh: 共同習慣連起不同世代與搬遷前後的生活；其他選項只談可能的成果或實用紀錄。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個推論超出了 anchor a family 的意思？

options.en: A regular gathering can give relatives a stable point of contact.
options.zh: 定期聚會可以讓親人有穩定的聯絡機會。

options.en: A shared tradition can anchor a family even when members sometimes disagree.
options.zh: 即使家人偶有分歧，共同傳統仍可提供穩定連繫。

options.en: A family that is anchored by one tradition can never have disagreements again.
options.zh: 只要有一個共同傳統作依靠，家人就永遠不會再有分歧。

contrast.explanationZh: 穩定感不代表消除一切分歧；比喻不能被理解成絕對保證。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「我們家分居兩地，但祖母仍每月主持線上故事夜。」你如何概括這個傳統，同時避免過度承諾？

options.en: That story night helps anchor the family, even if they cannot all join every time.
options.zh: 那個故事夜有助為家庭提供穩定連繫，即使大家未必每次都能參加。

options.en: It gives relatives a chance to hear their grandmother’s stories.
options.zh: 它讓親人有機會聽祖母說故事。

options.en: Online meetings can help some members stay in touch despite the distance.
options.zh: 線上聚會可幫助部分家人跨越距離保持聯繫。

dialogue.explanationZh: 金句指出傳統的穩定作用，同時承認出席未必每次齊全。

speaking.en: The monthly story night anchored the family while its members lived in different cities.
speaking.zh: 家人分居不同城市時，每月的故事夜為家庭提供了穩定連繫。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再指出讓家人保持連繫的事物。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：一家人因工作分住不同城市，仍每月合寫一份家庭新聞信，分享照片和近況。用一至兩句英文說明這個做法如何帶來穩定連繫，不要聲稱家人從此沒有分歧。
writing.selfCheckZh: 點出共同做法與持續連繫，並避免絕對保證。

examples.en: Their monthly newsletter helps anchor the family by giving relatives a regular way to share news and photos.
examples.zh: 每月新聞信讓親人定期分享近況和照片，有助為家庭提供穩定連繫。

examples.en: The newsletter anchors the family across different cities, although they still need to discuss important decisions separately.
examples.zh: 這份新聞信讓分居各地的家人保持連繫，但重要決定仍需另行商討。

glossary.en: a regular way to share news

takeaways.en: A shared calendar anchored the family during a year of changing work shifts.
takeaways.zh: 工作時間不斷變動的一年裏，共用日程為家庭提供了穩定安排。

takeaways.en: A familiar routine can anchor a family without settling every disagreement.
takeaways.zh: 熟悉的日常習慣可讓家庭有依靠，卻不能解決所有分歧。

lessons.titleZh: 把事物或做法傳給別人

brief.meaningEn: Transfer an item, skill, knowledge or custom to someone else so they can possess, use or continue it.
brief.meaningZh: 把物件、技能、知識或習俗傳給別人，讓對方擁有、運用或延續。
brief.grammar: Pass it on uses a clear prior referent for it; pass an item on and pass on a tradition show the split and unsplit forms. Name what is being transferred when the pronoun would be unclear.
brief.register: Everyday talk about family objects, skills and customs shared with others.
brief.boundaryZh: 原句的 it 沒有明說指甚麼；可以是傳統，也可以是物件。教會做法與單純交出成品是兩種不同的傳遞，要按情境說清楚。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要把來源中的 it 直接認定為傳統；也不要以為轉交一件成品便證明對方已學會製作。
brief.outcomeZh: 能清楚說明傳給別人的是物件還是做法，並正確使用 pass it on、pass an item on 或 pass on a custom。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 245, row 7; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: Grandparents can pass it on to their children.

listening.promptZh: 阿瑪爾希望孩子學到甚麼？

options.en: How to continue the annual paper-star custom themselves.
options.zh: 如何自己延續每年編紙星的習俗。

options.en: How to decorate the windows for this year’s gathering.
options.zh: 如何為今年的聚會佈置窗戶。

options.en: How to finish enough stars before the winter event.
options.zh: 如何在冬季活動前完成足夠的紙星。

options.en: How to make stars that look similar to Amal’s examples.
options.zh: 如何製作與阿瑪爾的示範相似的紙星。

listening.explanationZh: 她親自教孩子製作，目的是讓他們日後能延續這項年度做法；其他選項只聚焦今年的製作或外觀。
listening.en: Every winter, Amal shows the younger children how to weave paper stars for the neighbourhood windows. This year they made stars together so she could pass on the tradition.
listening.zh: 每年冬天，阿瑪爾都教年幼孩子為鄰里窗戶編紙星；今年她與孩子一起製作，藉此把這項傳統傳下去。

reply.promptZh: （主辦者如何延續家族製作燈籠的傳統？）

options.en: They invite children to make a lantern with older relatives each year.
options.zh: 他們每年邀請孩子與長輩一起做燈籠。

options.en: They pass on the tradition by teaching the younger generation each step.
options.zh: 他們逐步教導年輕一代，把這項傳統傳下去。

options.en: They record the pattern and explain what each design means.
options.zh: 他們記錄圖樣，並解釋各種設計的意思。

options.en: They hold an annual workshop where families practise together.
options.zh: 他們每年舉辦工作坊，讓各家庭一起練習。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都說明延續做法的方法；金句以本課片語概括跨代傳承。
reply.promptEn: How do the organisers keep the family lantern-making custom alive?

scene.promptZh: 一位阿姨不只送侄女剪紙成品，還每週教她折紙、畫樣和剪出節慶圖案。哪句最完整？

options.en: She is passing on the paper-cutting tradition by teaching the method.
options.zh: 她教授製作方法，把剪紙傳統傳給侄女。

options.en: She has given her niece several finished paper decorations.
options.zh: 她送了侄女幾件完成的紙製裝飾。

options.en: Her niece may choose a new design for the next festival.
options.zh: 侄女下次過節時或許會選用新圖案。

scene.explanationZh: 教會步驟才讓侄女有機會繼續剪紙傳統；送出成品只是情境的一部分。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個做法只能證明物件已轉交，卻不足以證明傳統做法也已教會對方？

options.en: An elder teaches the children why their community sings the song each spring.
options.zh: 長輩教孩子明白社區為何每年春天唱那首歌。

options.en: Someone gives a child a finished festival decoration but never explains or teaches the custom.
options.zh: 有人送小孩一件現成節日裝飾，卻沒有解釋或教授相關習俗。

options.en: A craft worker demonstrates the same technique and lets apprentices practise it.
options.zh: 工匠示範同一種技法，並讓學徒親自練習。

contrast.explanationZh: 現成裝飾可以被傳給小孩，但若沒有解釋或教導，便不能說相關做法也已傳承。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「祖父把舊鼓送了給孫兒，還每星期教他節慶演奏的節奏。」你怎樣突出傳承而非只說送禮？

options.en: He is passing on the drumming tradition by teaching his grandson the festival rhythms.
options.zh: 他教授孫兒節慶鼓樂節奏，把擊鼓傳統傳下去。

options.en: The grandson now has his grandfather’s old drum to practise on.
options.zh: 孫兒現在有祖父的舊鼓可以練習。

options.en: Their weekly lessons give the grandson time to learn the rhythms.
options.zh: 每週課堂讓孫兒有時間學習節奏。

dialogue.explanationZh: 金句說明被傳承的是節慶鼓樂做法，並點出長輩教導的行動。

speaking.en: The aunt passed on the paper-cutting tradition by teaching the children the festival patterns.
speaking.zh: 阿姨教孩子節慶圖案，把剪紙傳統傳了下去。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說出傳承的是甚麼以及如何傳承。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：社區長者每年教青少年製作手繪節日牌匾，並解說圖案的由來。用一至兩句英文說明傳承的具體做法；不要只說牌匾被送出。
writing.selfCheckZh: 明確指出被傳的是節慶牌匾製作傳統，並寫出教導或練習。

examples.en: The elders pass on the sign-painting tradition by showing teenagers the patterns and explaining their history.
examples.zh: 長者示範圖案並講解其由來，把手繪牌匾的傳統傳給青少年。

examples.en: By painting signs together each year, the community passes on the tradition and gives teenagers a chance to practise.
examples.zh: 社區每年一起繪製牌匾，把傳統延續下去，也讓青少年有機會練習。

takeaways.en: The baker passed on the festival bread tradition by teaching apprentices the recipe.
takeaways.zh: 麵包師傅教學徒食譜，把節日麵包傳統傳了下去。

takeaways.en: Grandfather passed the old drum on to his grandson; he also taught him the festival rhythm.
takeaways.zh: 祖父把舊鼓傳給孫兒，也教他節慶演奏的節奏。
